to be necessary, meaningful, worth of doing.

o.text: From Proto-Turkic *dẹg- (“to touch, reach”). Starostin et al. distinguish this root from the root *dẹg- (“to cost, to be worth, etc”), whence also Azerbaijani dəyər (“value”) and dəyişmək (“to change”), although the later Proto-Turkic root is usually considered to be a semantic development of the former. Cognate with Turkish değmek, etc.

From Proto-Turkic *dẹg- (“to cost, to be worth, etc”), whence also Azerbaijani dəyər (“value”) and dəyişmək (“to change”). Starostin et al. distinguish this root from the root *dẹg- (“to touch, reach”), although the former Proto-Turkic root is usually considered to be a semantic development of the later. Cognate with Turkish değmek, etc.
